name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 121 - Am 40
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 55g. Welcomes the progress made towards creating the ELDS but calls for harmonised metadata standards, machine-readable formats and the timely anonymisation and transmission of case-law to the ELDS, as well as the protection of workers, ensuring a smooth and just transition for affected jobs;
